goal: A fault classifier buckets each in-scope fault as TRANSIENT or PERMANENT and a bounded backoff helper produces monotonic-non-decreasing, capped waits.

relevant: packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/invoker.py -- collects api_error_status and rate_limit_events; classifier+backoff live near or beside this seam
packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/store_protocols.py -- StoreSchemaError is the PERMANENT case for the store side
packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_claims.py -- OrchestratorSchemaError is the other PERMANENT case
packages/flywheel-core/tests/test_invoker.py -- add backoff_bounded and transient_classification_matrix tests here
constraints: Define ONE shared TRANSIENT/PERMANENT classification (a typed/enum value) and ONE bounded-backoff helper that every downstream retry site reuses -- do not let later tasks fork their own buckets
The backoff helper must accept an injectable sleep/clock so waits are captured deterministically; growth is monotonic-non-decreasing and each wait <= a configured cap

The classification matrix in test_invoker.py must cover every in-scope fault (rate-limit/overload, SQLite locked-past-timeout, dropped PG connection, PG pool timeout -> TRANSIENT; schema mismatch -> PERMANENT) in one parametrized run
An optimistic-concurrency version conflict is NOT a TRANSIENT fault here (it is already loop-retried by the harness); do not classify it TRANSIENT
flywheel_core.task and flywheel_core.lifecycle stay pure (no json/pathlib/io/open); keep classifier/backoff out of those two modules
import flywheel_core must work without claude-agent-sdk; any SDK touch goes through the existing _sdk boundary only
Commit the change with a clear message before reporting done
non_goals: Do not wire the classifier into the API, store, pool, or worker sites yet -- downstream tasks consume it
Do not modify or weaken files under tests/ other than adding the two new tests named above; do not delete or relax existing assertions
Do not add a retry around version conflicts
edge_cases: A returned constant delay must FAIL the monotonic-growth assertion (sleep(0) is not backoff)
An uncapped exponential must FAIL the cap assertion
Schema mismatch bucketed TRANSIENT, or a dropped connection bucketed PERMANENT, must fail the matrix
